items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: But Rene had to pull a good pull over there because he used to live there on Cornice Street.

ctx.x: You say you used a lot of mutes.

I heard you used a mute and was good on the blues. Oh, on that Floyd's thing. The rubber plunger. Yeah. Oh I used to like him playing Kelly's Love. Song My hat over my arm and lay behind it. He was a good street man. In them days used to have some advertising. You get out on the street with a truck, you better be right. Don't a guy run you all over town. I remember one Sunday, this must have been about 2 o'clock, our band and Randy met there on Roman Street. We stayed there from 2 until after 5.
